title: When the mind is anxious in the day as it is
issueStatement: The mind keeps rehearsing danger before the future has even arrived. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru widens attention from imagined danger back toward Hukam, remembrance, and the care already present. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Peace begins when the mind stops arguing with what already stands inside Hukam. Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future.
actionPrompt: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
